title: Write 1 · 的 了 我 是 你 有 他 这 们 人 一 来 还 没 那
focus: 的 了 我 是 你 有 他 这 们 人 一 来 还 没 那
body:
The 15 most common characters. Before writing, learn the rules that decide stroke order; almost every character follows them.

## Core stroke-order rules
| Rule | Example |
|---|---|
| Top before bottom | 三: 一 then 二 |
| Left before right | 你: 亻 then 尔 |
| Horizontal before vertical | 十: 一 then 丨 |
| Left-falling (ノ) before right-falling (㇏) | 人, 大 |
| Outside before inside | 们's 门, then inside |
| Close the box last | 回 / 国: frame, inside, bottom line last |
| Centre before the sides | 小: middle hook, then the two dots |

## Watch out
- 辶 (in 这, 还) is written LAST, after what sits on it.
- 有 starts with ノ, then the horizontal; 在 (next lesson) starts with the horizontal.
- 我 ends with the top-right dot.
- 亻 person appears in 你, 他, 们.

cards.Notes: 白 white (5) + 勺 ladle (3) = 8 strokes. Write 白 on the left first, then 勺: ノ, 𠃌 hook, dot inside last.
2 strokes: ㇇ (horizontal-fold-left) then the vertical hook 亅. Lookalike: 子 adds a horizontal (3 strokes).
7 strokes: ノ, 一, 亅 hook, rising 提, then 戈-style: long slanting hook, ノ, and the top-right dot LAST. Lookalike: 找 (扌 + 戈).
日 sun (4) on top + 一 + a 止-like base (4) = 9 strokes. Top before bottom; the long sweeping ㇏ at bottom right is last.
亻 person (2) + 尔 (5, phonetic-ish) = 7 strokes. Left before right; in 尔 write ⺈, then the vertical hook, then left dot, right dot.
ナ (2) + 月 (4) = 6 strokes. Trap: in 有 the ノ comes BEFORE the horizontal (like 右); in 左/在 the horizontal comes first.
亻 person (2) + 也 (3) = 5 strokes. 也: 横折钩, then the short vertical, then the long 竖弯钩. Lookalikes: 她 (女), 地 (土).
文 (4) inside + 辶 walk (3) = 7 strokes. Trap: 辶 is written LAST, after the inner part, even though it sits on the left.
亻 person (2) + 门 door (3, phonetic mén) = 5 strokes. 门: dot, short vertical, then 横折钩.
2 strokes: ノ then ㇏ (left-falling before right-falling). Lookalike: 入 rù 'enter' has the right stroke on top.
1 stroke: a single horizontal, left to right. (Read yī alone; yì before tones 1-3, yí before tone 4.)
7 strokes: top 一, the two small dots (left, right), long 一, vertical 丨, then ノ and ㇏. Lookalike: 米 (no horizontals).
不 (4) + 辶 walk (3) = 7 strokes. Write 不 first, 辶 last. Same character as huán 'give back'.

cards.Prompt: ＿关系 · méi guānxi · it doesn't matter
cards.Notes: 氵 water (3) + 殳 (4: 几 then 又) = 7 strokes. 氵: dot, dot, rising stroke. Lookalike: 设 (讠).
Left part (4: 横折钩, 二, ノ) + 阝 (2) = 6 strokes. Left before right; 阝 last. Add 口 for 哪 nǎ 'which'.
